candidates.label: OpenMed PII Italian ClinicalLongformer
candidates.notes: WUL-96 benchmark stack is complete, but the model remains benchmark-only / not shadow-ready: full-corpus email recall is 0.333 and email-focused recall is 0.143, with critical mailbox leaks still present.

candidates.label: HUMADEX Italian Medical NER
candidates.notes: Current corpus v2 benchmark makes HUMADEX the leading deterministic candidate and the result is stable over 5 repeat runs: contractValidRate=1, spanPrecision=0.6, spanRecall=0.7, criticalRecall=0.7, evidenceCoverage=1, negativeCaseLeakRate=1. Promotion gate still fails on negative-case leaks and under-span problem phrases, so the lane remains benchmark-only.

candidates.label: OpenMed NER Secondary Baseline
candidates.notes: Measured on the same clinical_entities.v2 harness with openmed==0.6.3 and now repeated across 5 runs: contractValidRate=1, spanPrecision=0.5, spanRecall=0.6, criticalRecall=0.6, evidenceCoverage=1, negativeCaseLeakRate=1. Useful only as a secondary baseline; currently weaker than HUMADEX and also fails the promotion gate.
